entities.name: Query Cif protein
observations: The 290-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt A0A0H3B1Q8 from Yersinia pseudotuberculosis (100% identity and coverage; exact sequence hash match).
Annotated as protein-glutamine deamidase effector Cif, EC 3.5.1.44.
Deamidates Gln-40 of host NEDD8 to glutamate, disabling cullin-RING E3 ubiquitin ligase complexes; ubiquitin is also modified in vitro.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular mass 32,279.9 Da, theoretical pI 5.59, GRAVY -0.279, predicted charge at pH 7 approximately -9.43.
Pfam CIF domain PF16374 detected at residues 112-222.
Reference active-site residues are near positions 117, 173, and 193; query numbering is directly applicable because of exact sequence identity.
Reference annotation places the protein in the extracellular region and host nucleus, with secretion via a type III secretion system.

entities.name: NEDD8
observations: Cif targets host NEDD8 Gln-40, converting it to glutamate and thereby disrupting cullin-RING E3 ubiquitin ligase activity.

entities.name: Cullin-RING E3 ligase pathway
observations: Cif-mediated NEDD8 deamidation abolishes activity of cullin-RING ubiquitin ligase complexes.
